title: Nestle India receives ₹36.36 lakh EPFO demand, including ₹20 lakh penalty
description:
FMCG major Nestle India on Friday said it has received a demand of Rs 36.36 lakh from the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), including damages and a penalty of over Rs 20 lakh for the period 2012-2019.
The order has been issued by the Regional Office of EPFO, Mysuru, under section 7Q and 14B of the Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952, the company said in a regulatory filing.
"The company has received an order from the Regional Office of Employees' Provident Fund Organisation demanding an amount of Rs 36,36,548, which includes an amount of Rs 20,09,516 on account of damages/penalty for the period of 2012-2019 under PF Code," it said.
The order, received by the company on November 26, 2026, has no material impact on its financials, operations or other activities, the filing added.
